outline.chapter_title: Why QLoRA: Motivation, Contributions, and High-Level Idea
outline.description: Introduce the problem QLoRA solves, why finetuning large LLMs is memory-prohibitive, and how QLoRA makes 4-bit finetuning practical without sacrificing accuracy. Preview the Guanaco models and key results.
